verdict.rationale: Grafana exposes a documented HTTP API (openapi.json), an official CLI, provisioning/as-code workflows, and an MCP server for AI agents, indicating broad programmatic access to dashboards, data sources, alerts, and admin tasks. However, no evidence explicitly confirms full feature parity between UI and API (e.g., newer visualization types, Explore, or Assistant features may lack API equivalents), and community comments hint at documentation gaps for dashboard/data operations. missing for 10: explicit parity statement or independent verification that every UI action (e.g. Explore, drilldowns, AI Assistant) is API-accessible, and any hands-on confirmation of no API-only or UI-only gaps.
